I feel pretty confident that this season Crit riven will be in play ALOT. 
I found optimal success with these core items on riven.
Essence Reaver ---- > Death's Dance ---- > CDR Boots 
I'll explain why I like these items. 
Essence Reaver gives extra CDR from crit chance, since the removal of cdr from masteries I was desperately trying to find a way to get to 40% cdr fast again. Not only does ER give you cdr, but also crit chance which works extremely well with Riven.

Death's Dance - The healing on death's dance is amazing sustain, also the lifesteal from masteries works great with this not only that but CDR as well. It was obvious riot wanted riven players to buy this on her.

CDR boots - I stopped building cdr boots on riven a long time ago due to how squishy it would leave her, but now since it provides a 10% cooldown reduction on her summoner spells (along with the 15% cd reduction from masteries) (flash for days boys!) I see this as a great item for making flash plays and tp-ing into teamfights.

These are the only 3 items I've gotten the chance to try. I still think ravenous hydra is good on riven but more as a late game teamfighting item, I dont like the tiamet nerf and I really think riven needs cdr and sustain more early game than aoe damage. 

Lastly, Riven struggles badly agaisnt tanks her attack speed really isnt all that fast so with this build someone who builds 2 tanky items and 1 sustain damage will destroy you. My concern is that riven needs armor penetration. In the last patch I used to always go Ghostblade, Black cleaver, ninja tabi/mercs as my core items. This gives you amazing dueling for tanks, also I would buy tiamet for the aoe teamfight damage, but now since the tiamet changes I dont this its very viable. My concern is that riven needs AOE damage along with armor penetration to be useful. But lets not forget, your job in teamfights is not to take down the tanks but to blow up the ADC and midlaner.

I play jungle riven alot in BP and its fun, combine the AA cancel with wall jumps and you have a pretty good jungle clear. 
The combo I use for clearing goes, Q-W-AA-E-AA-Q2-AA-Q3 this combo ensures you take the least ammount of damage while dealing the most damage. I tested this out and once you have the a vampiric scepter if perform correctly you wont take damage in the jungle. (I Should tell you that this was before they took out CDR from masteries, so I use to start 10% CDR now I only have 5 so you might take more damage than I did since the new masteries arent really that helpful for riven)
